owner_instruction: Try the proven humanization process on the next section in one assistant turn; then use a separate Replit evaluator with the same evaluation logic and iterate up to six times if useful. Avoid model-shaped listicles and academic/therapist register. Preserve meaning and native embeds. After Pangram passes, keep a separate Target #2 ownerization/improvement overlay workflow.
authorized_delta: realization, cadence, paragraphing, sentence order within the natural section, and model-only explanatory packaging may change; claims, certainty, links/attributions, unique examples, practical instructions, safety functions, headings' substantive functions, and native embed placement may not change without owner authority
preservation_units: Deeper inner-child work requires enough adult capacity to pause, compare options, remain present, and act; when flooded/identified with a frightened child-state, outside support/regulation may come first and deeper dialogue can wait.
The Bottom-up Healing for Trauma & Addiction native digest-post embed remains immediately after the H1 opening and retains identity/placement.

Inner speech varies: distinguish spontaneous silent words from deliberate ability to think a sentence and from whether feeling preceded words in a particular moment; there is no required feeling-first/words-first sequence.

Voice/ask/answer need not mean literal internal dialogue; speech aloud, writing, drawing, picture/song, sensation/urge, or caring action may be used; low inner speech does not imply vivid imagery and quiet mind is not automatically resistance/failed contact.
Words may still help examine feelings, compare explanations, and choose action; plain analysis is not automatically avoidance and nonverbal feeling is not inherently deeper/truer.
Regulation section retains slower/non-forced exhales and gentle self-massage, including Joel's one-foot-massages-the-other Yin/Yang example and circular/spiral massage of tension.

Bottom-up options remain Shaking, tapping/EFT, EMDR, Brainspotting, Somatic Experiencing, Water Therapy, Massage, Energy Healing, or another bottom-up approach; order matters and the Somatic Therapy Modalities native digest-post embed remains in place.

Eyes-open/present-focused version is preferred when imagery pulls away from current room/time/body; if a session worsens function, compulsion, or present orientation, shorten it and use grounded support.

Catch-the-hook section: do not require immediate child/protector/origin identification; notice the hook first, including bodily tightening/heat/pulling back and urges to attack/explain/text/scroll/drink/disappear/promise/decide relationship meaning.
Pema Chodron attribution/link and shenpa concept remain: tightening/urge before complete storyline.

Acute hook response preserves these functions: orient to room/notice hook; unless immediate safety requires action, pause one to three breaths; feel bodily charge without deciding what it proves; identify needed adult function; take one small adult action or relax/continue day.
The activated story may be true/partly true/mistaken/mixed with older material; hook is not truth detector and pausing does not invalidate story.

Acute work asks what prevents harm in next ten minutes and what not to say/send/consume/promise/decide; meaning work later can examine younger state/protector, valid grievance, history, boundary, grief, repair, developmental need.
Distinguish observation/sensation from judgment and words literally present at the time from later verbal translation; later translation can still support understanding/testing meaning.
Inward work is not endurance; one breath may suffice, and loss of orientation/function or increased compulsion calls for stopping and external support.

Also Look Outward: not every hook is mainly old material; assess what the other person actually does, including disagreement tolerance, reflection, responsibility, room for your experience versus repeated self-abandonment.
Lindsay Gibson attribution/link remains; demonstrated relational capacity matters more than endlessly chasing motives/perfect explanations; expectations should follow repeated behavior.

Assessment stays specific/revisable: disagreement, time, or another person's boundary alone do not prove emotional immaturity; cannot/will not/cannot-now may be uncertain; protection need not wait for repeated danger; update judgment with behavior, not promises alone.
Guilt neither proves wrongdoing nor manipulation; distinguish harm requiring repair from abandoning position to stop another's disappointment, allowing both to coexist.

Choose realistic interaction outcome; mutual understanding may not be possible; conveying information, saying no, or ending without prolonged self-defense can count; action need not wait for being understood.
Witness/Protector/Guide functions remain applied to inside/between-us/next-sane-move.

Caring-editor practice remains: draft privately, stay on own side while fair, preserve valid protest/responsibility/request/boundary, better is not necessarily softer, choose send/less/pause/no response, and do not delay necessary protection to finish exercise.

Return care to the writer of the first draft; first draft is not automatically childish and may contain mature protest; edit communication without rejecting author; good response does not complete inward care.

More-processing section: real wound and unhelpful response can coexist; repeated checking whether grief/processing is correct can become the hook; another analysis round is not automatically more care.
Distinguish processing that increases feeling/understanding/decision/response from reassurance checking; revisiting familiar ground can be meaningful but repetition alone is not a new child request.
For checking loops, allow thought without arguing/chasing/waiting for complete resolution and return to chosen activity/relationship; caring for child need not require a meeting for every thought.

Evaluate practice by what it is supposed to help and observable change; calm/insight/explanation alone do not prove improvement; if approach yields no useful contact, more self-monitoring, or worse daily life, reconsider rather than intensify; keep what helps and meet need differently.
Exercises should not become a ritual required before living.
